title: 3D presenter character
description: A stylised 3D presenter built from code (three.js): a big-headed character at a desk in a warm, dim room with soft bokeh. Blinks, breathes, nods, switches expressions and gestures on time cues, and moves its mouth from a voice-over curve (tools/mouth_curve.py). Full-frame or in a rounded lower card for the split layout.
usage: engines/hyperframes/scripts/new-scene.sh <name> --template character-3d --params values.json   (needs: npm i three@0.170.0 gsap; mouth curve: python3 tools/mouth_curve.py voice.mp3 -o scenes/<name>/mouth.json --fps 30)

presets.creator: warm skin, short messy hair, stubble, headphones, orange hoodie
presets.teacher: grey side-part hair, round glasses, moustache, brown jacket over a light shirt
presets.chef: deep skin, buzz cut, full beard, chef's hat, white shirt with a red neckerchief
presets.coach: curly hair, broad build, coral t-shirt, cap
presets.analyst: auburn bun, square glasses, slim build, navy jacket over a white shirt

preset.description: One-word character choice. "custom" starts from neutral defaults; either way, keys in "character" override the preset.

character.description: Overrides for the preset. Keys: skin (light|fair|medium|tan|brown|deep or #hex), hair (messy|sidepart|bun|buzz|curly|long|bald), hairColor (black|darkbrown|brown|auburn|ginger|blonde|grey|white or #hex), brows (soft|thick|thin|arched), eyes (round|almond|sleepy|dot), eyeColor (#hex), nose (button|round|long|pointed), beard (none|stubble|moustache|full), beardColor (#hex, default hairColor), glasses (none|round|square), glassesColor, outfit (hoodie|tshirt|shirt|jacket), outfitColor, outfitColor2 (inner shirt / trims), build (slim|average|broad), headphones (true|false), headphonesColor, hat (none|cap|beanie|toque), hatColor, blush (true|false).

framing.description: close = head and shoulders (best for lower-card), medium = upper body and desk, wide = whole desk and room.

layout.description: full = the room fills 1080x1920 with title/caption on top; lower-card = backdrop with title on top, character in a rounded card in the bottom ~45 % (the split layout).

subjectY.description: full layout: where the character's centre sits vertically (0 top .. 1 bottom); raise it to leave more room for the title.

pushIn.description: Camera push-in over the scene, as a fraction of the distance (0 = static).

drift.description: Gentle sideways camera drift (0 = none, 1 = default).

expression.description: Expression at the start (cues change it later).

gesture.description: Default hand pose when no timed gesture is running.

cues.description: Timed changes, in scene seconds: {t, expression?, gesture?, duration?, look?, emphasis?}. expression: neutral|smile|surprised|thinking (holds until the next one). gesture: wave|point|chin|explain|typing|rest (wave/point/chin return to "gesture" after duration; defaults 1.8/1.6/2). look: camera|left|right|up|down. emphasis: true raises the brows and nods.

mouthCurve.description: "mouth.json": path next to index.html, written by tools/mouth_curve.py (you can also paste the JSON object itself into the params block of index.html). Empty: a seeded talking pattern for previews.

mouthOffset.description: Second of the voice-over at which this scene starts (when the scene is a slice of a longer voice-over).

talk.description: auto = follow mouthCurve (or the seeded pattern when it is empty); off = mouth closed (listening).

autoEmphasis.description: Brow raise + small nod on the loudest syllables of the curve.

seed.description: Seed for blinks, eye darts, hair tufts, bokeh and the preview talking pattern.

palette.description: Room colours: deep teal, charcoal or dark green wall, all with amber practical lights.

wallColor.description: Override the wall colour (#hex). Never purple.

lightColor.description: Override the warm practical light colour (#hex).

accentColor.description: Small accent (one key, mug stripe, headphone ring).

eyebrow.description: Small label above the title (empty hides it).

title.description: Title slot (empty hides it). One short line or one word works best.

caption.description: Caption slot near the bottom (empty hides it). For word-synced captions, layer templates/word-captions on top instead.

theme.description: Backdrop variant from base.css behind the card (lower-card layout).

shadows.description: Soft shadows from the key light (turn off for faster drafts).

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47). Sets <html lang>.

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: look at 4-5 stills: face readable, no z-fighting or holes, hands not through the desk
with a voice-over: render 3 s and check the mouth opens on syllables and closes in pauses
the voice-over audio sits in the scene as an <audio> clip (or in the final edit), never only in mouth.json
